years_since_diagnosis.evidence: Diagnosis at age 33, current age 36; 36 - 33 = 3 years since diagnosis.

occupation.evidence: busy career in finance. Sixty-hour weeks, eating at desk

location.evidence: Colonoscopy showed skip lesions throughout colon, classic Crohn's pattern.

severity.evidence: Two hospitalizations, failed multiple therapies (mesalamine, prednisone, azathioprine), now on biologic (Entyvio) that is losing effectiveness.

disease_control.evidence: Entyvio worked well for a year but is now losing effectiveness; patient is looking into Stelara as next option.

treatments.evidence: Started conservatively with mesalamine. Minimal improvement.

treatments.reason_stopped: Not sustainable due to mood swings affecting work
treatments.evidence: Added prednisone for flare control. The mood swings were horrible... Not sustainable in high-pressure job.
Moved to azathioprine. Three months in, liver enzymes spiked. Had to stop.
Started Entyvio infusions... Worked well for a year, then started developing joint pain... Entyvio losing effectiveness.
Added methotrexate for RA, which ironically might help Crohn's too. Side effects are rough - hair thinning, mouth sores, constant nausea. But the joint pain is manageable now.

encounters.evidence: Spent years being told IBS, stress, anxiety.
hospitalization for severe dehydration and weight loss forced the issue. Colonoscopy showed skip lesions throughout colon, classic Crohn's pattern.
Doctor recommended biologics but I resisted... Started Entyvio infusions... Looking into Stelara as next option. Entyvio losing effectiveness.
Rheumatologist confirmed RA. Added methotrexate for RA.

status.evidence: Started Entyvio infusions... Entyvio losing effectiveness. Looking into Stelara as next option.

barriers.evidence: Doctor recommended biologics but I resisted. Needle phobia since childhood. The thought of regular injections paralyzed me.

referral_steps_gp_to_prescriber.evidence: GP (years of misdiagnosis) -> hospitalization/ER where Crohn's was diagnosed -> GI specialist who prescribed Entyvio. Two steps from GP to prescriber.

extraction_notes: Methotrexate was added for RA but patient notes it may also help Crohn's; it is included in treatments as it has dual relevance. Stelara is mentioned as a future consideration but has not been started; biologic.status remains 'on' (Entyvio current). Dietary modifications (SCD diet, supplements, acupuncture) are not included as formal treatments. Metformin/insulin, Synthroid, fertility medications not mentioned. Rheumatologist encounter marked on_referral_path=false as it was a side consult for RA, not part of the Crohn's referral chain.
